answer: Rewards climb a ridge, not a cliff: a new agent earns 5% of the full payout, rising a step for each consecutive epoch in which peers attest its answer, and reaching the summit only after 30 straight epochs. Missing one resets the climb. A sybil farm can't swoop in like a falcon and grab a big haul; every fake must produce fresh, accepted work for a month before it pays, so the attacker's cost is the full compute of all those answers times every identity.
